correctness.rationale: The derivative quadratic has the exact positive curvature frontier \(B(c)\). In the convex–concave case \(N(r)=rf′(r)-f(r)+f(0)\) has derivative \(rf″(r)\) and exactly one interior zero. The explicitly glued chord, strictly concave section and plateau form a global concave majorant; Jensen bounds all Borel laws with the given finite mean. Strict contact/equality conditions establish uniqueness. Rare-long-distance two-atom sequences prove both nonattainment regimes. A standard-library checker independently exercises 206187 finite assertions; its sampling is not used for infinite-domain claims.

originality.rationale: The claimed mathematical content is the explicit sharp parameter-and-mean classification for one specified establishment response, not a new concave-envelope method or the biological concept of dimorphic seeds. Four relevant complete primary texts use different objectives, interactions or law constraints. Two particularly plausible older papers were limited to abstracts; remaining historical priority is provisional and is not certified by negative search alone.
residual_risks: Complete Harada (1999) lattice allocation text not accessible for direct theorem-level implication comparison; abstract clearly suggests different formulation, but hidden appendices/results are unknown.
Complete Ezoe (1998) Gaussian seed-size tradeoff text inaccessible; abstract does not describe the unrestricted fixed-first-moment optimization.
The universal concave-envelope moment theorem is classical, so novelty is restricted to the exact applied curve and sharp phase diagram, not to convex analysis itself.
Unindexed mathematical ecology literature or an exact previously published model of the same survival function may exist; originality remains best-knowledge provisional.

value.rationale: The prescribed mean dispersal distance is a natural but weak transport-budget summary. The theorem classifies every possible optimal probability law and exact parameter boundary under a biologically motivated near-parent predator exposure and exponential transport mortality. It identifies a genuine two-atom dispersal phase and sharp nonattainment for mean distances beyond the pointwise optimum, showing why mean-only planning cannot guarantee feasible optimum without tail constraints. It is a structural complete classification, not an arbitrary finite enumeration or ecological efficacy claim.
